ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.eLogix_Bypass_Validation_Rules), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Customer_Code__c)), OR(ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCity), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(Phone)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A logistics customer (an account with a Customer Code) must have a billing street, city, postal code and phone number.
